source.title: Feralas Mission XIV: Defeat Alondrius
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Twin Colossals. Defeat the keeper of the grove Alondrius there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat Alondrius in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion patrolling the road at the Twin Colossals and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
